messages:
elaine: quick design review request for the Compliance settings panel (retention + region + encryption). screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc - looking for microcopy + accessibility nits before I hand to eng.
maria: nice layout. small wording thing: the retention tooltip says 'What we delete' which feels passive. suggest: 'What gets deleted: generated outputs and derived artifacts'. clearer and helps legal.	noah: behavior nit: if user selects 'Private region' we currently show a secondary confirmation modal. can we instead show an inline confirmation row that expands under the region selector? modal feels heavy.	taylor: KMS label accessibility: current badge reads 'KMS' visually and has title attr. For screen readers that's insufficient. Recommend visible label 'Customer key (KMS)' and add role="img" aria-label="Customer-managed key" if you must keep the badge compact. Also color contrast on the orange badge fails AA in dark theme.	jamal: copy for audit export button: change from 'Download logs' to 'Export audit trail (CSV)' + small suffix: 'Includes admin events. Sensitive user content redacted by default.' put that suffix as visually muted helper text, not a tooltip.	telaine: good call. also add a one-line helper under retention slider: 'Retention applies to generated outputs (responses, embeddings); prompts and raw inputs are stored per customer settings.' helps set expectations.	design-bot: a11y-scan: KMS-badge contrast FAIL (AA 3.0). Tooltip focus-order WARN (tooltip button inserted before region select). Keyboard-nav PASS for slider but needs aria-valuemin/valuemax labels.	maria: mobile layout: region picker expands full-screen and hides the 'use customer key' toggle. prefer collapsing the key toggle into a sticky footer on mobile so users can review before saving.	noah: UX flow: when toggling 'Use customer key' we should surface required IAM roles inline. quick line: 'Requires KMS:roles/cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on key <key-id>'. show as code block.	taylor: microcopy: change 'Region' dropdown label to 'Data region (where outputs are stored)'. that forces clarity.	jamal: dev note: avoid tooltip z-index hacks; reposition tooltip on small widths under the element. fallback to ellipsis + info page link if space insufficient.	telaine: I'll update the figma text and push a PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2514 with copy + a11y tweaks. tagging @noah for final signoff.	noah: thanks. also let's add a short line to release notes: 'Clarified retention language and improved KMS badge accessibility.'	design-bot: accessibility-check-summary: contrast issues, tooltip order, missing aria on slider. See /a11y-scans/1749720001-report.json.
